extracted.intended_audience: Heads of Executive Departments and Establishments (federal agency leadership)
extracted.subtask_description: OMB memorandum notifying agencies that provisions of OMB Circular A-64 related to employment ceilings are superseded and consolidated into OMB Circular A-11, and specifying which portions of A-64 remain in effect. Directs where agencies must look for derivation, issuance, monitoring, and reporting instructions for FTE ceilings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidation of employment ceiling instructions into OMB Circular A-11
rubrics_metrics.description: All instructions from the Executive Office of the President related to the development, implementation, or revision of employment ceilings are to be consolidated in a single instruction — OMB Circular No. A-11 (Transmittal Memorandum No. 54, dated July 19, 1983).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant portions of Circular A-11 (e.g., section 13 and Appendix D) contain the guidance agencies must use going forward. Effective with issuance of A-11 (Transmittal Memorandum No. 54), agencies must consult Circular A-11 for employment ceiling matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partial rescission of A-64 employment-ceiling provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific portions of OMB Circular No. A-64 that pertain to employment ceilings are rescinded and superseded by Circular A-11.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The rescinded portions include: (a) references to employment ceilings in section 1 (Policy); (b) references to employment ceilings in section 2(c); (c) Sections 4, 5 and 6; and (d) Attachment C. OMB Bulletin No. 83-5 (October 14, 1982) is also superseded with respect to employment ceilings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Derivation, issuance, monitoring, and reporting of FTE employment ceilings
rubrics_metrics.description: All instructions regarding the derivation, issuance, monitoring, and reporting of full-time equivalent (FTE) employment ceilings are contained in OMB Circular A-11.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies should use the procedures and reporting requirements set out in Circular A-11 (not A-64) for managing FTE ceilings. This centralizes responsibility and ensures consistent practice across executive agencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Position management provisions of A-64 remain in effect
rubrics_metrics.description: The portions of OMB Circular No. A-64 that pertain to position management systems are not rescinded and continue to be in effect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While employment-ceiling material has been superseded by A-11, agencies must continue to follow A-64 for position management system guidance and requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective date and notification to agency heads
rubrics_metrics.description: This memorandum notifies heads of executive departments and establishments that the changes take effect with the issuance of OMB Circular No. A-11, Transmittal Memorandum No. 54 (dated July 19, 1983).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies are formally advised by this transmittal to adopt the consolidated instructions in A-11 effective as noted; administrative action should follow accordingly to align agency practices with A-11.
